name: mentor-ai-root
description: MentorAI - Production-Ready AI Accountability Mentor MVP

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run prisma:push --prefix backend && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend
